title: G and D synchronization requirement
description: The generator and discriminator must be carefully synchronized during training; if G is trained too much without updating D, the model can collapse.
canonical_description: generator and discriminator must be carefully synchronized during training to prevent mode collapse

evidence.quote: D must be synchronized well with G during training (in particular, G must not be trained too much without updating D, in order to avoid ``the Helvetica scenario'' in which G collapses too many values of z to the same value of x to have enough diversity to model p_data)
